Each row in the discussions list now has a **Comments** column with the comment count and a **Last Comment** column with the date of the latest comment, or "No comments yet". As you asked, I did not run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been run or checked yet.

**What changed (all in `apps/react-vite/src`):**
- **Mock API** (`testing/mocks/handlers/discussions.ts`): `GET /discussions` now returns `commentsCount` and `lastCommentAt` with each discussion. `lastCommentAt` is the time of the newest comment, or `null` when there are none.
- **Type** (`features/discussions/api/get-discussions.ts`): I added a `DiscussionListItem` type (a discussion plus the two new fields) and the list request now uses it.
- **List** (`features/discussions/components/discussions-list.tsx`): added the two columns, using the existing `formatDate` for the date.
- **Keeping the numbers current:** without this, after you add or delete a comment the list could show the old count for up to a minute. Features may not import from each other, so the change is wired through the app route:
  - A new `useInvalidateDiscussions` hook in `get-discussions.ts` reloads the list.
  - The discussion page (`app/routes/app/discussions/discussion.tsx`) passes it to `<Comments onCommentsChange>`.
  - That callback is passed down to `CreateComment` and `DeleteComment`, which call it when a comment is created or deleted.
- **Test** (`app/routes/app/discussions/__tests__/discussions.test.tsx`): the existing test matches the full text of a row, so I added the new columns to it (`... 0 No comments yet View Delete Discussion`).
